title: cost-delta-inspector-and-quant-sandbox-runner
author: Maya Thompson
description: Summary: Introduce a lightweight tenant-aware cost delta inspector and a quantization sandbox runner (CLI) to simulate tenant-level unit economics under quantization and caching changes. Motivation: customers frequently ask for safe ways to evaluate how quantized candidates and cache heuristics affect per-token cost and tail-latency for real tenant traffic. This PR adds an offline simulator and a short-circuit telemetry hook so teams can run what-if experiments without touching live routing. Changes include: 1) econ/delta_inspector service that consumes sampled KV-cache + request traces and computes token-level cost deltas for candidate quant profiles and batching configs, emitting aggregated metrics under econ.delta.v1; 2) quant-sandbox CLI (bin/cost-sandbox) that can run deterministic replay with injected quantization noise models and optional prefix caching toggles per tenant; 3) small runtime adapters to add simulate_quant and simulate_cache flags to the serving runtime test harness used by the sandbox; 4) a unit-econ evaluator that maps runtime metrics to per-request USD estimates using the existing cost model and tenant billing metadata; 5) dashboard panels and saved queries for the Console (observability-cfg) that visualize delta distributions and risk bands; 6) safety: sandboxed runs never call production model endpoints and use a synthetic inference backend shim by default. Backwards compatibility: all runtime flags are opt-in and disabled in mainline; telemetry tags are namespaced and can be filtered. How to use: cost-sandbox run --tenant my-tenant --trace-file sample-trace.ndjson --quant-profile q8_3 --batch-policy preferred_small --output report.json. The output report contains aggregated token-econ, tail-Latency95/99, and recommended conservative fallback (e.g., switch to q4f16 for 99th percentile latency violations). Implementation notes: the quant noise model is a stochastic sampler learned from small profiler runs; it is not a replacement for full FP->int model validation but sufficient for candidate ranking and SLO risk estimation. This PR purposefully keeps the production control plane untouched; only the observability and offline tooling live here. Related: ENG-2873 linear ticket for tenant-safe profiling, SUP-4421 customer escalation for quant regressions. Testing: unit tests for the cost mapper and a small end-to-end sandbox integration test with synthetic traces. Rollout plan: merge behind feature-flag "econ.delta.inspector"; notify infra and support teams; schedule a shadow run for two tenants before enabling wider self-serve.

review_comments: Samir Rao: Can you clarify how the quant-noise sampler is calibrated? We should include a link to the calibration harness in the commit that adds it.
Maya Thompson: Added calibration notes and a small script under test/fixtures/calibrate_quant.sh. The sampler is fit on profiler token deltas using a bootstrap estimator; not meant for production QA.
Lina Chen: Please ensure the telemetry tags include tenant_id obfuscation. We cannot send raw tenant IDs into the aggregate pipeline.
Maya Thompson: Adjusted telemetry emission to hash tenant IDs and added a config flag to toggle raw_id in non-prod environments.
Diego Alvarez: One nit: prefer a dry-run flag on the CLI to avoid writing large reports by accident.
Maya Thompson: Added --dry-run which runs the simulation and prints a short summary to stdout without writing the report file.
Samir Rao: Approving pending CI green and documentation note about feature flag rollout.
release_notes: Add econ delta inspector and cost-sandbox CLI to run offline tenant-level cost/latency simulations for quantization and caching changes. Feature gated behind econ.delta.inspector; includes telemetry econ.delta.v1 and small Console dashboard templates.
